Ond opens straight into your library instead of waiting for the server, and keeps working when the server is away. A new Offline mode shows only what plays without it. The format pill now shows whether a song is downloaded or streaming, and opens the full signal path.

### Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `Ond-0.4.1-macos-universal.dmg` (or `.zip`) | macOS 11 or later, Apple silicon and Intel |
| `Ond-0.4.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Linux on x86_64, glibc 2.39 or newer (Ubuntu 24.04, Fedora 40, Debian 13) |
| `Ond-0.4.1-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | Linux on ARM64, same requirements |
| `Ond-0.4.1-windows-x86_64.zip` | Windows 10 and 11. Still untested on real hardware; issues welcome. |

On NixOS or with Nix: `nix profile install github:Solidsilver/ond/v0.4.1`. Install steps for every platform are in the [README](https://github.com/Solidsilver/ond#install).

### Starting up and staying up

- With a saved login, Ond opens into your library right away and connects in the background. The footer shows Connecting… until it's through.
- A song you play while Ond is connecting waits for the server, then plays.
- If the server can't be reached, the footer says Can't reach server and Ond keeps trying. It retries right away when your computer wakes and when you bring the window to the front.
- If the server turns down the saved login, your library stays up and the footer asks you to sign in again.
- Playlists, favorites and Recently added are saved on your computer, so they're there when Ond starts without the server.
- Songs still whole in the stream cache play without the server, like downloads.
- New setting, Settings › Offline › Songs that aren't downloaded: while the server is away, playback skips to the next song that can play (the default), or pauses.

### Offline mode

- Turn it on in Settings › Offline, or from the footer's menu with Go offline. Ond doesn't connect to the server and shows only music that plays without it: downloads, and songs in the stream cache.
- The sign-in screen has a Keep browsing offline link.
- Go online from the footer to connect again.

### Where a song comes from

- The format pill in the now-playing display and in the Player shows a small down arrow when the song plays from your computer. No arrow means it's streaming.
- Click the pill for the signal path: the source, format, anything that changes on the way to the device, the output, and the mode (Normal or Bit-perfect, and why not when it isn't). The output menu stays on the speaker button.
- Downloaded playlists have the download mark in the sidebar.

### Smaller changes

- New speaker and offline icons.
- The output button's status dot only shows in bit-perfect mode.
- The seek line in the now-playing display is centered under the title.
